af5d255482bb9478.description: Responsibilities JOB DESCRIPTION Conducts periodical safety rounds around entire area of company premises for ensuring safe atmosphere and condition. Ensures plant & warehouses Safety and hygienic condition are maintained and reports deviation if any. Ensures plant related employees are wearing appropriate overalls/clothing’s and PPE (Personal Protective Equipment). Checks the Safe operation and condition of machineries across production area. Ensures perfect condition of fire-fighting equipments thru periodical maintenance and re-filling of equipments as applicable- Maintains necessary documents for recording the daily, weekly and monthly HSE inspection activities. Monitors the hot works & ensures they are carried out with due permission and safe condition across the plant (carried out maintenance/contractor/third part etc). Coordinates with Security guards in line with visitors’ movements, keeping track of entry and exit to company premises etc.- When required, conduct Safety & first-aid on the job trainings for new recruits- Participates in evacuation drills. Ensures the clear way to reach fire extinguisher and hose cabinets across company- Takes fire preventive measures on need basis especially during summer time- Monitors the condition of drainages/canals and ensure them against infestation thru pest control spray activities incoordination with department heads. Increases health and safety awareness at all levels within the organization. Investigates and reports all serious / critical personal injury accidents occurring to staff, visitors or contractors. Investigates accidents / incidents that result to a substantial damage to company properties. Responds to employees safety concerns. Responds immediately to fires and other emergency situations. Coordinates registration and removal of hazardous waste if any. Coordinates the training of personnel in areas of safety testing, including first aid, CPR, accident prevention and Investigation, work place inspections and other matters related to implementing safety procedures in facilities. Assists executive staff, senior administrators, principals and supervisors and HSE team leader in emergency situations. Conducts operational risk assessments on site and designs risk mitigation measures. Generates and maintains all the required reports related to HSE management system, including corrective action and Preventive measures. Provides HSE improvement proposals stating: the non conformance, proposed corrective action, required resources for corrective action and plan of implementation.

af3b64065655d3c9.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm dedicated to delivering a better world through various projects, including improving commutes, providing access to clean water, and transforming skylines. With over 50,000 professionals worldwide, AECOM partners with clients to address complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. The company is a Fortune 500 firm with a revenue of $* billion in fiscal year 2025. The Opportunity: Senior Manager Construction (High-Rise) AECOM is seeking a Senior Manager Construction (High-Rise) to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with operations extending to Jeddah. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves leading the comprehensive management and administration of high-rise construction projects, ensuring alignment with PMC standards and best practices, particularly in vertical construction methodologies and multi-story coordination. Key Responsibilities Manage and administer high-rise construction projects, establishing project-specific objectives, policies, and protocols in line with PMC standards and best practices, with a focus on vertical construction and multi-story coordination. Provide strategic management and guidance to subordinate managers and supervisors, enforce company and project policies, and act as the primary liaison between AECOM, clients, and design teams on complex high-rise developments. Oversee all aspects of high-rise project construction to ensure compliance with design specifications, budget, and schedule through subordinate managers, supervisors, and trade partners. Apply design background to coordinate design-build integration and resolve design-related construction challenges specific to multi-story environments. Administer projects from pre-construction budgeting and scheduling through design coordination, procurement, shop drawing development, RFI management, construction execution, space turnover, and contract closeout. Manage design coordination meetings to ensure seamless integration between design intent and field execution across multiple floors and phased construction sequences. Maintain significant profit/loss responsibility for assigned high-rise construction projects, managing complexities such as vertical logistics planning, material hoisting coordination, multi-story safety protocols, and multi-phase coordination. Coordinate with design teams and consultants to address constructability issues, identify value engineering opportunities, and manage design modifications while maintaining project schedule and budget integrity across all vertical phases. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in construction management, with a strong focus on high-rise developments and vertical construction. Demonstrated expertise in managing complex multi-story projects from inception to completion. Proven ability to manage project budgets, schedules, and design compliance. Strong leadership and communication skills for liaising with clients, design teams, and internal stakeholders. Work Environment and Commitment This full-time position is based in Makkah, with project involvement in Jeddah. AECOM is committed to a secure recruitment process, requiring all newly hired employees to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. AECOM fosters a workplace built on respect, collaboration, and community, offering opportunities for professional growth and development through award-winning training programs and groundbreaking projects. All information provided will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

afb8bc3a7c079896.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن أخصائي جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تصميم وتطبيق معايير الجودة، وتحليل رضا العملاء، وتطوير أنظمة تدقيق الجودة لضمان أعلى مستويات الأداء والخدمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل وتصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة، وتحديد وتطوير مواصفات ومعايير ومؤشرات لمختلف العمليات والمخرجات. المساهمة الفعالة في تطوير معايير ومواصفات الجودة المطلوبة للمبادرات والبرامج والمخرجات قيد التطوير، بما يتوافق مع خطط العمل المحددة. إعداد وتطوير استبيانات لقياس مستوى رضا العملاء عن جودة الخدمات والعمليات والإجراءات، وتوثيق وتحليل توصياتهم التحسينية. تطوير أنظمة وإجراءات ونماذج تدقيق الجودة، والمشاركة في وضع خطط التدقيق الدوري والسنوي، وتنفيذ عمليات ضبط وتدقيق الجودة بدقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالجودة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الجودة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تصميم وتطبيق أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لدراسة رضا العملاء وتطوير أنظمة الجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، الخرج. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق التميز في الجودة عبر جميع عمليات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة.

afb312fad64a30e3.description: About Alstom and the Role Alstom is a global leader in sustainable and smart mobility, providing a broad portfolio of transport solutions including high-speed trains, metros, monorails, trams, and integrated systems. With over 80,000 colleagues worldwide, Alstom focuses on advancing greener and smarter mobility. This Full-time position for a POS BIM/CAD Coordinator is based in Riyadh, requiring 0-1 years of experience. This role involves collaborating with various teams, including Design Leaders, BIM Coordinators, and Construction Managers, to produce detailed design drawings and ensure compliance with quality standards. Alstom operates in 63 countries and is committed to diversity and inclusion, fostering an inclusive workplace for all employees.

af0dd7db41a89098.description: About the Role Advanced Metals Company (AMCO) is seeking a Procurement Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves managing the procurement process from requisition to vendor selection and order placement, ensuring efficient and commercially sound purchasing for the company. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to handle purchase requisitions and Bills of Material, execute actual purchasing activities, prepare purchase orders, and facilitate vendor selection. The Procurement Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that all procurement processes align with company standards and commercial protections. Key Responsibilities Receive and review 'Stores Requisition' for goods and services. Receive and review the 'Bill Of Material' for job-related purchasing. Receive documented proposals or quotes and record tender information, including vendor price, delivery terms, and conditions. Manage all subcontracting related jobs, including but not limited to fabrications, machining, calibration, and building maintenance. Conduct value analysis and life cycle costing in conjunction with the supply chain manager. Ensure all relevant information, drawings, and procedures specified on the purchase requisition or any relevant specification are enclosed with the purchase order. Place purchase orders within delegated authority, ensuring the company is fully protected commercially. Ensure that goods and services are procured only from approved suppliers. Update the supplier database in accordance with protocol and QC Department involvement when a new supplier is added. Liaise with suppliers via telephone and mail as required. Review Purchase Requisitions with the Procurement Lead before issuing a Purchase Order. Communicate the progress of ordered goods and services to internal customers. Maintain a manual file/log of Purchase Orders with date of purchase, job number, level of inspection, originator, or traceability for ERP backup. Send Requests for Quotation (RFQs) with all relevant details to suppliers. Develop strategies for cost-effective procurement. Utilize supplier performance data and previous history (checked within the ERP system) before placing orders. Rationalize the vendor database by establishing partnerships and framework agreements with key vendors. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a procurement or related engineering role is required. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Dammam. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

af434f244f2b2ac4.description: مساعد طبيب أسنان في مجمع توكير الطبي يبحث مجمع توكير الطبي في الرياض عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقه بدوام كامل. يركز هذا الدور على دعم أطباء الأسنان وضمان سير العمليات اليومية للعيادة بسلاسة وكفاءة، مما يساهم في تقديم رعاية ممتازة للمرضى. نبذة عن الدور يتولى مساعد طبيب الأسنان مسؤولية تقديم الدعم الشامل لطبيب الأسنان والمرضى على حد سواء. يشمل ذلك التحضير للعمليات، المساعدة أثناء الإجراءات، وضمان تعقيم الأدوات والمعدات. الدور يتطلب دقة واهتمامًا بالتفاصيل لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي طب الأسنان، بالإضافة إلى توثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في ملفاتهم. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان، والتأكد من تفقد وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان بشكل صحيح. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة للأسنان، وخلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء عمله، بما في ذلك مناولته الأدوات والمواد وسحب اللعاب. تفقد أدوات ومعدات العمل وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منتظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مساعد طبيب الأسنان. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفعال. الالتزام بالمعايير الصحية والتعقيم. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في مجمع توكير الطبي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في العيادة لتقديم الدعم اللازم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مجمع توكير الطبي.

afe1ac7fa67b5d02.description: Job description JOB PURPOSE This role exists to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation of factory electrical, instrumentation and automation systems. The role also supports maintenance strategy and coaches Technical Operators in engineering and manufacturing-system practices. Service, troubleshoot and verify process-control instruments, and ensure instruments and sensors remain within calibration requirements. Troubleshoot PLC-based systems, I/O modules, HMIs, SCADA, VFDs, servo systems, special-function modules, OT networks and integrated systems. Perform preventive maintenance, inspections and routine checks, and monitor equipment parameters to reduce planned and unplanned downtime. Diagnose and repair faults in machinery, instruments, electrical systems, control panels and automation equipment to restore safe operation quickly. af9bd309051caded.job_title: Principal Specialist Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology)
af9bd309051caded.description: About Ma'aden Ma'aden, established in 1997, is a prominent multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company plays a role in developing the mining industry as a key economic pillar for Saudi Arabia, focusing on building an integrated mining value chain. Role Overview The Principal Specialist, Data Modeling & Arch Enterprise, leads the design, modeling, and evolution of enterprise data architecture. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, ensures that data products, curated layers, and integration patterns are standardized, scalable, high-quality, and governed. The specialist defines how operational and corporate data are modeled, aligned, and transformed to support analytics, reporting, AI enablement, and trusted consumption across business domains. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise business domains and data architecture principles. Define canonical models, conformed dimensions, master/reference data structures, and reusable modeling patterns for cross-domain consistency. Design data product models and curated layer schemas supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, AI use cases, and downstream integrations. Establish enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, guidelines, reusable templates, and quality expectations for delivery teams. Partner with data governance teams to align business glossary definitions, stewardship ownership, metadata, lineage, and critical data elements. Lead the creation and optimization of data product schemas, curated layers, semantic structures, and consumption-ready models. Define modeling approaches for various data platform requirements, including relational, non-relational, time-series, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and analytical platforms. Define integration patterns to ensure consistent transformation logic, metadata, lineage, and data quality across source-to-consumption pipelines. Act as a senior technical authority for data modeling and architecture decisions across enterprise data initiatives. Mentor data modelers, data engineers, analysts, and delivery teams on modeling standards, patterns, review practices, and quality expectations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in data modeling and enterprise data architecture. Demonstrated ability to lead the design and evolution of complex data architectures. Experience in defining and implementing data governance principles within data models. Proficiency in various data modeling techniques and platforms. Success Factors Success in this role is measured by the standardization, scalability, and reusability of enterprise data models, alignment with business domains, and improved semantic consistency across domains through canonical models and naming standards. It also includes the effective support of trusted reporting, analytics, and AI enablement via curated layers and data product schemas, alongside the embedding of metadata, lineage, data quality, stewardship, and governance into modeling and integration patterns. Providing strong modeling assurance and practical design guidance to delivery teams is also a key indicator of success. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

af9e2d29922b9794.description: HSE Manager Role Overview DAR ENGINEERING is seeking an experienced HSE Manager to lead Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) management for a large-scale program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, on-site position reports to the Program Director and is responsible for establishing the HSSE direction, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, client requirements, and international standards across all contractors, subcontractors, and consultants. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the program HSSE plan, policies, and procedures in line with client requirements, applicable Saudi laws and regulations, and internationally recognized standards such as ISO 45001 and ISO 14001. Lead, coach, and develop the HSSE team across the program's projects, setting clear roles, accountabilities, and performance expectations. Set leading and lagging HSSE targets and KPIs, and report performance and risks to program leadership and the client. Review and approve contractors' HSSE plans, method statements, risk assessments, and permit-to-work arrangements before work commences. Monitor HSSE performance during construction through site inspections, audits, and walkthroughs, ensuring timely closure of non-conformances and corrective actions. Integrate HSSE considerations into design reviews, constructability reviews, and planning of construction activities. Lead hazard identification and risk assessment, ensuring effective controls for high-risk activities such as working at height, excavation, lifting, confined spaces, and temporary works. Ensure compliance with national and international HSSE laws and regulations, and manage permitting processes and interfaces with regulatory and resource agencies. Oversee occupational health and industrial hygiene, environmental compliance and waste management, and site security arrangements, in coordination with the client and contractors. Lead incident and near-miss investigations, root cause analysis, and sharing of lessons learned across the program. Prepare regular HSSE reports, statistics, and dashboards for management and the client, and support internal and external audits. Identify and implement improvements to HSSE systems, processes, and best management practices to minimize impacts during project execution. Qualifications and Experience The ideal candidate will possess deep technical HSSE knowledge and proven leadership experience on large construction programs. A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field is required, along with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and foster a strong safety culture from planning through project completion. Work Environment and Benefits This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with an on-site work arrangement. The company supports a healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours, allowing some flexibility in daily start and finish times while maintaining a structured working schedule of up to 48 hours per week. Benefits include competitive salary and benefits, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and support for wellness. Relocation support is available for qualified candidates. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to submit their application online by the deadline of November 10, 2026. DAR Engineering is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by the Talent Acquisition team for a selection process that typically includes two interview stages.

af620664372161ac.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيوت أجمل للديكور والتصميم الداخلي عن فني تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء، فهم احتياجاتهم، وإدارة عملية المبيعات والتعاقدات، بالإضافة إلى متابعة المشاريع من البداية وحتى التسليم النهائي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء والتواصل الفعال معهم لفهم احتياجاتهم ومتطلباتهم بدقة. تقديم خدمات التصميم الداخلي وشرح تفاصيل الخدمات والعروض المتاحة للعملاء. متابعة العملاء وتحويل الاستفسارات الأولية إلى فرص مبيعات وتعاقدات فعلية. إعداد عقود المبيعات الخاصة بخدمات التصميم والتنفيذ، والتأكد من استكمال جميع البيانات المطلوبة فيها. رفع وحفظ جميع معلومات وبيانات العملاء، العقود، والمستندات ذات الصلة في نظام الشركة المخصص (الدرايف). التواصل المستمر مع العملاء عبر الجوال المخصص للشركة لمتابعة طلباتهم والإجابة على استفساراتهم. التنسيق الفعال مع العملاء والمنفذين لضمان سير العمل في المشاريع وفق المتطلبات المتفق عليها. متابعة مراحل تنفيذ المشروع بشكل دوري والتأكد من معالجة أي ملاحظات أو تعديلات والتنسيق بشأنها. متابعة المشروع حتى اكتماله التام والتأكد من تسليمه للعميل بالشكل المطلوب والجودة المتوقعة. التأكد من إغلاق المشروع بشكل كامل واستكمال جميع المستندات والبيانات الخاصة به. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم حلول تصميمية مناسبة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفرغ الكامل للمهام الموكلة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

af85965235c73c96.description: About Deloitte Deloitte is a global professional services firm recognized for its impact on clients, people, and society. The firm provides innovative insights, solves complex challenges, and aims to unlock sustainable growth. Deloitte fosters an inclusive and collaborative culture, supporting professionals in delivering value to clients and contributing to market confidence and trust. The Role: Consultant Manager, Cyber Operate Penetration Tester Deloitte is seeking a Consultant Manager, Cyber Operate Penetration Tester, to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves planning, executing, and reporting on penetration tests across various systems and environments. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Plan and Scope Engagements: Agree on scope, objectives, rules of engagement, and test windows with system owners, obtaining written authorization before testing. Select appropriate testing approaches (black-box, grey-box, white-box, external, internal, announced, unannounced) and follow defined methodologies (NIST SP 800-115, PTES, OWASP) while ensuring safety for live services. Conduct Penetration Tests: Perform tests on web applications and APIs (authentication, authorization, business logic, injection, session handling, API security per OWASP Testing Guide and ASVS), mobile applications (iOS, Android, back-ends per OWASP MASTG), internal and external networks (perimeter exposure, segmentation, lateral movement, privilege escalation), Active Directory and identity (attack paths, Kerberos weaknesses, misconfigurations, credential exposure), cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP for misconfigurations, excessive permissions, exposed services), and wireless/physical systems (corporate/guest Wi-Fi, physical access controls where authorized). Run Red and Purple Team Exercises (Senior): Plan and lead objective-based red team exercises emulating realistic threat actors, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Conduct purple team sessions with the Security Operations Center (SOC) to test and improve detection and response capabilities. Report and Drive Fixes: Write clear, risk-rated reports with evidence, attack narratives, practical remediation steps, and an executive summary. Brief technical teams and management on results, explaining business impact. Retest fixes, confirm closure, and pass validated findings to Vulnerability Management and Risk for tracking. Build reusable test cases, scripts, and checklists to enhance testing efficiency. Leadership Capabilities Develop an understanding of Deloitte's purpose and values, exploring opportunities for impact. Demonstrate commitment to personal learning and development, acting as a brand ambassador. Understand expectations and maintain personal accountability for performance. Actively develop effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understand how daily work contributes to team and business priorities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in penetration testing or a related cyber security field. Demonstrated capability in planning and executing various types of penetration tests. Experience with relevant methodologies such as NIST SP 800-115, PTES, and OWASP. Proficiency in reporting findings and driving remediation efforts. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, within a professional services environment. The role involves working with diverse teams and clients to address complex cyber security challenges.

afb7ce5b9c442ccd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الباب العالي السعودية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود، وتدقيق الحسابات البنكية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وإعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. نطاق العمل يشمل الدور إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. كما يتضمن إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وحفظ التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الباب العالي السعودية.

afc23c9435696182.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فيتال ميديتك عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم العمليات المخبرية الكيميائية، بما في ذلك تركيب الأجهزة وصيانتها وإجراء التجارب. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الكيمياء مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الحيوية لدعم سير العمل في المختبر الكيميائي، مع التركيز على الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير المعتمدة. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تركيب وتشغيل أجهزة المختبر الكيميائي وفقاً للمخططات التوزيعية المعتمدة وتعليمات المشرف الكيميائي والشركة المصنعة. دراسة التجارب الكيميائية المطلوبة وتحديد الظروف والشروط والمستلزمات اللازمة لإجرائها بالتنسيق مع الكيميائي. إجراء التجارب الكيميائية بدقة وفقاً للمعايير المعتمدة وتعليمات الكيميائي، مع استخراج النتائج وتسجيلها وتوثيقها. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لأجهزة المختبر الكيميائي حسب تعليمات الشركة المصنعة لضمان كفاءة الأداء. إعداد وتقديم تقارير التجارب الكيميائية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. صيانة وتشغيل معامل قسم الكيمياء، وتنفيذ خطط الكلية لدعم العملية التعليمية وخطط السلامة العامة وإدارة المخاطر. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخلفية التعليمية والخبرة العملية اللازمة للتعامل مع المهام الكيميائية والمخبرية بكفاءة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال فني الكيمياء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تركيب وتشغيل أجهزة المختبر الكيميائي. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة المخبرية. القدرة على إجراء التجارب الكيميائية واستخراج النتائج بدقة. مهارات إعداد التقارير الفنية وتوثيق البيانات. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكيمياء في مؤسسة فيتال ميديتك ضمن بيئة مخبرية في نجران، حيث يساهم في دعم العمليات التعليمية والبحثية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة وإدارة المخاطر في المختبر. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في نجران. سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد تقييم المرشحين وموافقة الجهة المعنية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

afc24bead9335733.job_title: Regional Capability Lead for Middle East
afc24bead9335733.description: About the Role BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is seeking a Project Manager – Capability Development to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading the targeted development, deployment, and continuous improvement of Programme/Project Management Capabilities within BAE Systems Saudi Arabia. The Project Manager will ensure that policies, processes, and toolsets are fit for purpose for the Business Unit (BU) needs and will continuously measure and report on the position of PM capabilities through maturity assessments. Company Overview BAE Systems operates as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor under Government-to-Government arrangements to provide equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and provides training for RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capability through the growth of Saudi National Partner Companies, reinforcing industrialisation and partnerships. Key Responsibilities Develop and continuously improve Project Management Capabilities across lines of business and functions. Ensure designated Project Management Improvements are identified and deployed to the Business Unit, providing regular updates to stakeholders. Provide interfaces, domain expertise, and knowledge in the delivery of Project Management Capability to all stakeholders. Capture, develop, and implement new and existing Project Management competencies and capabilities (Policies, Processes, and Toolsets) within the Business Unit. Implement PM Assurance and Maturity Assessments to measure current capability levels, identify gaps, and provide evidence of delivery and associated benefit returns of strategic capability deployments. Manage the PM Capability Development team, including the development of improvement plans and the management and reporting of their execution. Establish Information and Knowledge Management capability to capture Lessons Learned and identify Continuous Improvements within PM Governance and Capabilities. Support the development and deployment of Corporate Project Management Council and Performance Excellence capabilities. Support the implementation of BAE Systems Saudi Arabia’s “Fit for Purpose” activities and projects. Provide PM Functional representation at Line of Business Programme and/or Project reviews. Deploy relationships between the PM function, business units, wider community, and cross-functions. Support Corporate PM Council working groups as the nominated representative. Hold responsibility for applicable financial budget identification and reporting against agreed headcount. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management or capability development. Demonstrated ability to establish and lead Project Management Improvement Working Groups. Experience in supporting the establishment, development, and growth of PM capabilities for a Project Management Community. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on supporting national agendas and industrial partnerships. Application Process Candidates interested in this Project Manager – Capability Development role are encouraged to apply.

afed4cb8b12c67d9.description: About the Role Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking an Information Security Manager to lead and manage all activities related to protecting the company's digital and physical information assets. This full-time role, based in Jeddah, involves implementing and maintaining data security policies and procedures to ensure data remains secure and compliant with regulatory requirements. The Information Security Manager will coordinate with various teams to identify weaknesses, manage data security incidents, and provide strategic guidance on data protection. Key Responsibilities Manage the implementation of the data security strategy and develop/enforce data security procedures in line with company goals and compliance. Respond to data security incidents, conduct post-incident analysis, and implement preventive measures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to protect data asset inventory and integrate data security best practices across the organization. Execute training and awareness programs on data security practices and the importance of protecting classified information. Oversee the selection and implementation of data security tools and technologies, and monitor industry trends and threats. Provide expert advice and guidance on data security matters to senior management and stakeholders. Define and establish access controls for classified data resources in collaboration with data owners. Manage reviews of access controls and permissions, and oversee the process for granting, modifying, and revoking access to data resources. Approve identity and access management requests for various data systems (database, dataset, USB, SAP, cloud drives, e-vaults, internet URL access, DLP, RMS) to prevent data breaches. Monitor user access review activities across the company's data systems. Develop and implement processes for handling data subject requests (access, rectification, deletion). Ensure data privacy best practices are integrated throughout the organization and monitor compliance with data privacy laws and regulations. Lead Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new and existing projects. Manage the organization's data breach response and notification procedures. Strategic Contribution and Management Ensure effective cascading of divisional strategy into sectional business plans for vertical alignment and horizontal integration. Manage the achievement of assigned objectives by leading the designated section, setting individual objectives, managing performance, and developing staff. Lead talent development initiatives for the assigned section, ensuring talent availability to meet business requirements. Manage the preparation and recommendation of the sectional budget, and monitor financial performance against the budget. Ensure effective implementation of policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of assigned sectional activity. Lead the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement and sustainability of systems, processes, and practices. Ensure timely and accurate preparation of all department reports, meeting company requirements and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience in information security or a related field. Demonstrated experience in managing data security strategies, procedures, and incident response. Proven ability to manage identity and access management processes. Experience with data privacy regulations and conducting Privacy Impact Assessments. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, focusing on protecting the information assets of Jeddah Central Development Company.

af67c44bd66844cf.description: About Red Sea Global and the Role Red Sea Global (RSG) is seeking an Assistant Boat Captain for a full-time position in Al Wajh. af89bbe3338e9290.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع أنشطة الصيانة، بدءًا من التخطيط وتوزيع المهام وصولاً إلى تقييم الأداء وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل الخاصة بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو الإشراف عليها. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات جيدة في تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير فرق العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات في مدينة تبوك. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع أعضاء الفريق والإشراف المباشر على عمليات الصيانة المختلفة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: تبوك. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

afcbd96f9753febb.description: About the Role OSAS Medical is seeking a Cosmetic Dermatologist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This is a full-time, on-site position focused on providing comprehensive dermatological consultations and managing skin conditions with an emphasis on cosmetic and aesthetic treatments. The role involves working directly with patients to develop and implement personalized treatment plans. Key Responsibilities Perform cosmetic and aesthetic procedures, including chemical peels, laser treatments, and injectable therapies. Address patient concerns such as acne, scars, pigmentation, and skin rejuvenation through evidence-based interventions. Develop individualized treatment plans tailored to patient needs. Provide counseling to patients on skincare practices and preventive measures. Ensure the delivery of safe and high-quality care in accordance with current medical standards. Collaborate effectively with clinical and administrative teams. Maintain accurate and thorough medical records. Adhere to all regulatory and infection-control guidelines. Participate in ongoing professional development and clinical quality improvement initiatives. Compensation Model Compensation for this role is based on a production-based percentage model, directly linking income to clinical expertise and work performance. Work Environment The successful candidate will work in a supportive, high-end clinical environment equipped with the latest medical technology and equipment. The clinic also provides a dedicated social media team to assist in reaching potential new clientele.

af11893d4aaa33a3.description: About the Role HCLTech is seeking a Track Lead - Program & Project Management for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is central to ensuring operational excellence through effective project execution and team empowerment within the Support & Operations function. Role Purpose The Track Lead focuses on continuous improvement and problem-solving to meet client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The position involves fostering a collaborative environment that contributes to organizational success and drives progress through strategic project management and operational enhancements. Key Responsibilities Enhance operational systems by implementing project management methodologies and tools to improve management reporting and streamline information flow across teams. Analyze client requirements and ensure the support team delivers exceptional service that meets or exceeds client expectations, utilizing DMO principles for optimal outcomes. Lead and mentor project teams by facilitating transparent communication of goals and expectations, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance. Drive innovation by identifying opportunities for process development and implementing best practices that contribute to overall organizational progress. Provide tailored solutions that align with customer needs and organizational capabilities, leveraging project management expertise to achieve business results. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role emphasizes a collaborative environment focused on achieving operational excellence and continuous improvement. Application Process Candidates interested in this Track Lead position are encouraged to apply.

af24db08a5949546.description: About the Role Keeta is seeking a Human Resources Business Partner to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves acting as a strategic partner to line management, focusing on employee engagement, compliance, and talent development within the business units. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Business Partnering and Employee Engagement The HR Business Partner will serve as a trusted advisor and coach to line management across various business units. This includes consulting and supporting managers on people-related issues, measuring employee engagement, and implementing actions to improve it. The role also involves acting as a change agent to facilitate organizational transitions. Reporting and Compliance Present weekly HR priorities in key meetings. Prepare and submit WBR reports. Ensure compliance with local laws and Group policies throughout the employee lifecycle. Communicate and implement changes to HR policies and procedures. Ensure proper application of disciplinary procedures before employee exits. Create and review employee policies to align with company policy and local regulations. Employee Relations Support line managers in fostering a culture of employee engagement, meritocracy, performance-focus, and diversity. Advise line managers to educate them and minimize risk in employee relations. Manage outsourcing manpower vendors to ensure service standards and cost-effectiveness. Organize team activities to enhance employee engagement. Training and Development Conduct annual training needs analysis to develop the Learning & Development proposal and calendar. Ensure new employees receive proper induction and support for quick productivity. Identify and deliver training for key and high-potential staff. Ensure successors are identified for all key positions. Track progress of high-potential employees and review their development with line managers for advancement assessments. Prepare regular presentations for Line Managers on people status. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in human resources, with a strong background in business partnering, employee relations, and talent development. The role requires a professional who can effectively advise management, ensure compliance, and drive engagement initiatives.

af251a24f48ad08d.description: About Assystem Radicon Assystem is dedicated to accelerating the global energy transition by focusing on low-carbon energy solutions. With 7,000 professionals, the company combines engineering expertise, project management, and digital technologies. Assystem operates in 12 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, contributing to the production and distribution of low-carbon electricity through nuclear and renewable energy development. The company also supports the modernization of energy grids, manages new transmission and distribution network setups, and utilizes hydrogen for decarbonizing transport and industry sectors. Assystem Radicon is seeking an IT Project Coordinator to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose The IT Project Coordinator will support the successful planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects. This involves coordinating stakeholders, managing project activities, tracking risks and issues, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. Key Responsibilities Coordinate end-to-end IT project activities across the full project lifecycle, from initiation to closure. Monitor project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation. Identify project risks, issues, and bottlenecks, and proactively drive mitigation actions. Facilitate communication between business stakeholders, vendors, technical teams, and project managers. Track project progress and prepare status reports, dashboards, and management updates. Support project governance, change management, and documentation processes. Coordinate contract-related activities including Statements of Work (SOWs), deliverables tracking, vendor performance, and compliance with contractual obligations. Utilize project delivery and collaboration tools to manage project workflows and reporting. Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Commitment to Diversity Assystem is committed to equal treatment of candidates and promotes all forms of diversity within the company. The organization believes that diverse backgrounds and perspectives are essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions.

af5b1a4f36c985ec.company_name: مكتب حسين طه المصري للاستشارات الهندسية
af5b1a4f36c985ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتجاهات الاربعة للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على المشاركة في إعداد وتطوير التصاميم والمخططات المعمارية للمشاريع، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الرسومات التنفيذية والنماذج ثلاثية الأبعاد والمناظير المعمارية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير المخططات والتصاميم المعمارية للمشاريع المختلفة. تطوير الأفكار والتصورات التصميمية وتحويلها إلى حلول معمارية قابلة للتنفيذ. إعداد الرسومات التنفيذية والتفاصيل المعمارية بدقة. نمذجة المشاريع وإعداد المجسمات ثلاثية الأبعاد. إعداد المناظير والإخراج المعماري عالي الجودة. تطوير الواجهات والعناصر المعمارية بما يتناسب مع متطلبات المشروع. مراجعة وتعديل المخططات وفق الملاحظات والمتطلبات الفنية. التنسيق الفعال مع المهندسين من مختلف التخصصات لضمان تكامل التصاميم. تجهيز ملفات العرض والتقديم للمشاريع. الالتزام بجودة ودقة المخططات وتنظيم ملفات المشروع. متابعة متطلبات المشاريع والالتزام بالمهام والمواعيد المحددة. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب العمل والتعلم المستمر في مجال التصميم والعمارة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على التفكير والتصميم المعماري. المهارات التقنية إتقان برامج الإظهار المعماري مثل Lumion و D5 Render. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق هندسي متكامل، مع التركيز على التعلم المستمر وتطوير المشاريع. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمتطلبات المشروع وجودة الإخراج ودقة المخططات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه.

afd6ef4ca06084c4.description: About the Role Mace is seeking a Senior Interface Manager (Utilities) to join their team in Tabuk, with work locations including Umluj. This full-time role involves leading the management of technical, construction, commissioning, operational, and stakeholder interfaces for major utility production assets and infrastructure plants. Project Context The Senior Interface Manager will ensure effective integration across utility plant packages, network infrastructure contractors, utility operators, authorities, commissioning teams, and programme stakeholders. The focus will be on the successful delivery and integration of major infrastructure facilities, including power, district cooling, desalination, sewage treatment, potable water production, ICT infrastructure, and centralized utility systems. This position is critical for managing plant-to-network and plant-to-plant interfaces, utility operator requirements, and operational readiness activities across multiple contractors and workstreams. Key Accountabilities Establish and manage the package interface management framework across all utility plant assets. Lead interface coordination among power plants, substations, district cooling plants, desalination facilities, sewage treatment facilities, ICT infrastructure, and associated utility networks. Manage interfaces between plant contractors, utility network contractors, utility providers, authorities, operators, and programme stakeholders. Develop and maintain interface registers, responsibility matrices, and interface agreements. Coordinate technical interfaces across civil, process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, controls, ICT, and operational systems. Manage plant-to-network integration requirements to support testing, commissioning, energisation, and operational handover. Facilitate interface workshops and multidisciplinary coordination meetings. Identify interface risks and drive timely mitigation and resolution strategies. Support operational readiness planning and integration with future operating entities. Monitor interface performance and provide regular reporting to programme leadership. Core Responsibilities Promote Mace's Safety First value, exhibiting visible safety behaviours, sharing lessons learned, and utilising safety moments and Mace's HSW framework to support the safety and wellbeing of all staff. Possess technical expertise in local health and safety rules and regulations relevant to the project portfolio. Promote a diverse and inclusive working environment and understand the importance of team wellbeing. Ensure robust quality systems are in place and managed in line with service excellence. Manage delivery from project inception/brief through design development, planning, contractor procurement, and construction phase, in accordance with the overall delivery program and agreed project milestones. Manage tasks and associated deliverables in support of senior leaders and the wider project and client teams to ensure timely and accurate project delivery. Manage project budgets and highlight any risks, challenges, and mitigations. Support the long-term development of the function or Business Unit (BU), contributing to a sustainable business future. Commit to making a positive impact for people, clients, and the planet, and hold others accountable for upholding Mace values. Manage design and wider consultant teams collaboratively to ensure effective completion of responsibilities. Lead and manage the project team and relevant stakeholders to achieve strategic project key performance indicators (KPIs). Actively network, innovate, and seek understanding of best practice, utilising the full depth of knowledge of Mace Group, the Centres of Excellence, Mace Way Control Centre, and Knowledge Hub. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants are encouraged to apply even if they do not fulfill all criteria, as they may still be suitable for this role or another within the organisation. Discussions regarding part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options are also open if suitable for the role.

affe13cd2ffd0249.description: About Mace Group Mace Group combines construction expertise with consultancy services. The company focuses on unlocking potential in projects and redefining ambition. This role is for a Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure Specialist based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position. Role Overview The Senior Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination, delivery assurance, and stakeholder integration for complex infrastructure projects. This role requires senior project management discipline, technical infrastructure insight, and delivery experience to ensure project outcomes are achieved safely, on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. The projects involve premium buildings and supporting infrastructure for a private estate, encompassing a diverse portfolio of high-value developments. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end infrastructure project delivery, from strategy, planning, and mobilisation through design coordination, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover, and closeout. Establish robust project governance, delivery controls, baseline schedules, cost controls, risk management, issue resolution, and reporting rhythms aligned with programme requirements. Integrate multidisciplinary technical inputs across civil, utilities, transport, buildings, public realm, systems, interfaces, and enabling works to support coordinated delivery. Manage senior stakeholders, authorities, consultants, and contractors to drive decisions, remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope, quality, safety, commercial, and schedule objectives. Provide strategic advice to programme leadership on constructability, sequencing, procurement strategy, delivery risks, interface constraints, change impacts, and recovery options. Champion HSE, quality, sustainability, compliance, and assurance expectations across the project lifecycle. Required Deliverables Approved project execution plans, mobilisation plans, delivery strategies, interface plans, and stakeholder engagement plans. Integrated schedules, lookahead plans, progress reports, dashboards, risk and issue registers, decision logs, and escalation papers. Package delivery plans, procurement and tender inputs, technical evaluations, change impact assessments, and recovery/action plans. Governance meeting packs, executive reporting, assurance responses, lessons learned, and closeout documentation. Qualifications and Experience This position is open to Saudi Nationals. Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated experience in managing complex infrastructure projects with high standards of design, planning, and execution. Application Information The salary for this position will be not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

af32b9f289c97497.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة الإستثمار الذكي عن مدير تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى مدير التسويق مسؤولية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بالتسويق، والإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة وتخطيط أعمال التسويق لضمان التوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية وتوفير الموارد اللازمة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بالتسويق، ومتابعة هذه الخطط لضمان كفاءتها وفعاليتها، وتحديد الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لقياس مستوى تحقيق الأهداف. تطوير الخطط التسويقية السنوية والخطط الإعلانية والبرامج التسويقية والترويجية للجهة بالتنسيق مع الوحدات التنظيمية والجهات ذات العلاقة. الإشراف على تطبيق الخطط التسويقية والإعلامية للجهة، وضمان حسن تنفيذها وفق الإجراءات والأوقات والموازنات المتفق عليها، والتأكد من فعاليتها في خدمة الأهداف التسويقية للجهة. بناء علاقات استراتيجية مع الشركاء الخارجيين مثل شركات الإعلان، والعمل معهم لإعداد ونشر كافة الإعلانات والمواد التسويقية المتعلقة بالجهة والوحدات التنظيمية التابعة لها. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد الدراسات التسويقية ومتابعة توزيع الكتيبات والمطبوعات وغيرها من المواد التسويقية المتعلقة بالجهة وخدماتها، وضمان نشرها وتوزيعها بما يتناسب مع أهداف الجهة التسويقية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال التسويق. القدرة على وضع وتطوير الخطط التسويقية والاستراتيجيات الإعلامية. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. القدرة على بناء وإدارة العلاقات مع الشركاء الخارجيين. نوع الوظيفة والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. الراتب غير معلن. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير التسويق ضمن فريق متخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن ضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية التي تضمن سير العمليات اليومية بأكبر كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

af55282ecb857d31.description: About Air Products Air Products, founded in 1940, is a world-leading industrial gases company with a history of innovation and operational excellence. The company is committed to safety and environmental stewardship, working towards a cleaner future for its customers, communities, and the world. Role Overview Air Products is seeking a Sr Contract Administrator to join its team in Tabuk, specifically on-site in Duba, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position focused on implementing and administering existing contracts within a current project. The role operates on an 8x2 rotation schedule, with 60 hours per week. Key Responsibilities Manage FIDIC-based re-measurable subcontracts for EPC contractors. Apply and administer various contract commercial models, including Unit rates, reimbursable, and Lump Sum. Manage and administer changes and claims. Prepare and maintain detailed Minutes of Meeting (MOM) and formulate contractual correspondence such as letters, site instructions, and Change Order Requests (CCO). Collaborate with other project teams including engineering, construction, commissioning, project controls, and commercial. Implement project subcontracts strategy, identifying life-of-project requirements and working with planning and cost/estimating to align budget allocations. Oversee performance management of contracts. Support structured weekly and monthly reporting. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree is mandatory. A minimum of 8-15 years of experience in a similar role. Strong experience within an EPC Oil & Gas company is required. Work Environment and Schedule This position is based on-site in Duba, Tabuk, KSA. The work schedule follows an 8x2 rotation, with a commitment of 60 hours per week.

af7d58973d288a0b.description: About Unifonic and the Role Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company focused on digital transformation through cloud communication. As a Customer Solutions Consultant, you will lead collaboration with virtual sales, engineering, and support teams to drive the adoption of cloud communication solutions. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Customer Solutions Consultant builds and maintains strong customer relationships, influencing long-term strategic direction and serving as a trusted advisor to CXOs and technology decision-makers. Responsibilities include evaluating cloud communication strategies, recommending solutions, removing deployment roadblocks, and ensuring successful adoption and customer satisfaction. The role involves working with Unifonic's conversational AI and omnichannel communications platform. Key Responsibilities Act as a technical liaison between Sales and Product teams during the sales process, supporting solution design, quotes, proposals, RFP responses, and related documentation. Develop working knowledge of Unifonic's conversational AI and omnichannel communications platform. Participate in Sales team meetings to understand customer pain points, requirements, and business goals, and help shape relevant solutions. Support problem escalation and best-practice efforts to assist clients and internal teams in using Unifonic's products effectively. Build and deliver product demonstrations and pilots that showcase Unifonic's value to prospects and clients. Relay timely, organized client feedback to Product Management, Sales, Support, and Development based on real business cases. Hand off won deals to the Customer Success team with clear context on customer goals and configuration. Support Sales and Account Management on upsell and cross-sell opportunities with technical input. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Support, Engineering) as needed to close deals. Required Experience and Skills Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. The role requires a professional who demonstrates the following characteristics: Analytical thinking and problem-solving: Ability to approach problems clearly, use data, and identify solutions. Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility and ensures projects are completed. Communication: Explains ideas clearly and listens effectively across teams. Collaboration: Works effectively with others to support team goals. Adaptability and learning: Adjusts to change and continuously acquires new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing: Supports the growth of others and shares expertise. Resilience: Maintains composure under pressure and handles setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail: Performs work carefully and strives for continuous improvement. Advocacy and innovation: Encourages best practices, efficiency, and new ideas. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the hiring process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

afb040a5e346046f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سول العربية التجارية عن مشرف إنشاء طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على تنفيذ مشاريع إنشاء الطرق، وضمان الالتزام بالمواصفات والمعايير الفنية، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتضمن الدور مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وجودة عالية: دراسة المخططات الهندسية للطرق ووثائق المناقصة، وإعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل بالتنسيق مع مهندس الطرق المشرف. تقدير كميات المواد وحجم العمالة اللازمة لتنفيذ المشاريع. متابعة إجراءات ونشاطات تنفيذ الطرق لضمان التقيد بالمواصفات المحددة. أخذ عينات عشوائية من مواد إنشاء الطرق وإرسالها إلى المختبر للفحص ومطابقة المواصفات، بناءً على تعليمات مهندس الطرق المشرف. أخذ عينات عشوائية من الخلطات الإسفلتية وإرسالها إلى المختبر لمطابقة المواصفات. قياس الأعمال المنجزة بالتنسيق مع مهندس الطرق المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إنشاء الطرق أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمواصفات الفنية ومعايير الجودة في مشاريع الطرق. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية ووثائق المناقصات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على المتابعة الدقيقة لخطط وبرامج العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعاون مع مهندس الطرق المشرف والفريق. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل يتطلب التواجد في مواقع المشاريع حسب الحاجة. يعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص في تنفيذ مشاريع البنية التحتية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة سول العربية التجارية.

afef49c564c8f5db.description: About The First Group The First Group is seeking a Front Office Manager to lead front desk and guest service operations at Silver Sands Beach in Jeddah. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Front Office Manager will be responsible for ensuring a welcoming, efficient, and professional experience for all guests. This role involves supervising the front office team, coordinating with other departments, and supporting smooth daily operations to maintain high service standards. Key Responsibilities Manage reception, guest services, bookings, check-in/check-out, and cashiering procedures. Lead, schedule, train, and motivate the front office team. Handle guest inquiries, complaints, feedback, and service recovery. Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, security, and operations teams. Maintain accurate guest records, reports, payments, and shift handovers. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and Saudi regulations. Support VIP visits, special events, peak periods, and seasonal operations. Monitor guest satisfaction and identify opportunities to improve service quality. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a front office or guest services management role. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team effectively. Strong understanding of hotel operations and guest service best practices. Work Environment This role is based at Silver Sands Beach in Jeddah and operates on a full-time schedule. The Front Office Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure seamless guest experiences. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

afefc9b36bace771.company_name: مصنع شركة دار القاسم للمنتجات الورقية
afefc9b36bace771.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلول الصناعية المتقدمة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين الذين يمتلكون خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويهدف إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء المحتملين والحاليين لدعم نمو المبيعات. المهام الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع، واستعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المسؤوليات الأساسية البحث عن عملاء محتملين والتواصل معهم عبر المكالمات، الزيارات، البريد الإلكتروني، LinkedIn، والفعاليات المهنية. استهداف أصحاب الأعمال، المؤسسين، مديري العمليات، وصناع القرار في الشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة. فهم بيئة العميل واحتياجاته لتحديد الفرص البيعية. تأهيل الفرص البيعية بناءً على الاحتياج، الميزانية، صاحب القرار، والجدول الزمني المتوقع للتعاقد. توضيح القيمة التجارية للخدمات المقدمة. إعداد عروض الأسعار والمقترحات التجارية بالتنسيق مع الفريق الفني، والتأكد من ملاءمتها لنطاق احتياج العميل. ترتيب التقييم الفني الأولي عند الحاجة قبل تقديم العرض النهائي. التفاوض مع العملاء ضمن السياسات والأسعار والصلاحيات المعتمدة، وإتمام إجراءات التعاقد. متابعة العميل منذ أول تواصل وحتى توقيع العقد وتسليمه إلى فريق التشغيل بصورة منظمة. تسجيل جميع الاتصالات، الاجتماعات، الفرص، والعروض في نظام إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM). إعداد توقعات المبيعات والتقارير الأسبوعية، وتحديث مراحل الفرص بدقة. متابعة السوق والمنافسين ورفع الملاحظات المتعلقة باحتياجات العملاء، الأسعار، والخدمات المطلوبة. الالتزام بعدم تقديم وعود فنية أو زمنية أو تجارية خارج نطاق الخدمات واتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.
